information.description:
Rats are slightly superior scum that have acquired (stolen) gear that doesn’t break the moment you use it. They still can’t shoot for shit and don’t sport any worthwhile protection, but hey, at least they’re trying a little to be a tougher lowlife.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Scavengers).

description.value:
Everyone in Night City knows the characteristic rattle of this submachine gun. Designed in the 2040s, Militech intended the Saratoga to be a versatile piece in their corporate security arsenal. However, its advantages – small frame, light weight, relatively cheap price, ease of use and modifiability – also rendered this SMG a major hit outside the glass towers of Corpo Plaza. This is the ideal weapon for vehicular and urban combat.

Cost: 350eb (Expensive)

Class: SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 40 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 3 • Attachments: Foregrip • Mods: None

Special Features: Has 1 extra Attachment Slot (4 Total). While wielded in two hands, this weapon is considered Excellent Quality [Foregrip].

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Foregrip (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

The Quasar is perhaps the most distinctive weapon you can find in Night City. It features an unusual, angular frame, classic disc magazine and one-of-a-kind technology. After all, the Quasar is an electromagnetic gun. The barrel holds four electrically charged shafts, which, in combination with the bullet, form opposing electromagnetic poles. The resulting forces release the bullet – at lightning speed. A shot from the unassuming Quasar can even pierce armored vehicles and bulletproof vests.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 16 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with all Capacity modifying Attachments. While this weapon’s Tech Rebuild is charged, it is only capable of using Autofire. This weapon only expends 8 rounds when using Autofire. If there are not 8 rounds left for Autofire, the entire magazine is expended.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
Simple Leather armor for your head. No armor penalty.

Cost: 100eb (Premium) ♦ Install: Mall

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Originally intended for special operations use, this quickly-abandoned implant enables projecting a one-way holographic mask over the user’s face, entirely obscuring it while still providing full vision.

External Body Cyberware. While active, this cyberware masks the user's face from external sources, including cameras. Anyone attempting a Human Perception or Lip Reading check against users with this cyberware active takes a -2 penalty to their check. Counts as an instance of Gang Colors Jewelry for Scavengers, if tweaked to the right display setting. Turning this cyberware on or off takes an Action. NOTE: This is the digital facemask that Scavs use in 2077. The World of 2077 book specifically mentions “K.E.R.S” for the Scavengers, so that’s what this was inspired by.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
